###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:255:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:255:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:255:3)


התביעה הפנימית של הדבקות האלהית, הבאה בחטיבה מיוחדת בנשמתן של ישראל, היא עליונה בעצמה מכל מחשבה הגיונית ע"פ שפע רוח הקודש היא מתישבת בלב, וע"פ תקות ישועה היא מתאמצת ומתפשטת בכל החוגים המעשים, התופסים מקום בחיי הכלל ובחיי הפרט.


The inner demand to cling to the Divine, which comes as a unique unit in the soul of the people of Israel, is in itself higher than any logical thought. In accordance with the flow of Divine inspiration, it settles in the heart, and in accordance with the hope for salvation, it strives and spreads across all this-worldly realms that play a role in the life of the community and in the life of the individual.



### Paragraph 256

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:256:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:256:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:256:1)


כשהחושב מתבודד, ומתגלה בנפשו אז הכח הרוחני הפנימי שלו, חש הוא את כל הפגמים שנפגמה נשמתו, מכח מעשים ומדות שאינן הגונות,


**Repentance Via Sufferings Is Also Repentance**
When a thinking person engages in solitary introspection and his inner spiritual ability is revealed within him, he senses all of the ways in which his soul has been blemished due to his improper deeds and traits.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:256:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:256:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:256:2)


מצטער הוא אז בצער פנימי ועמוק, וחותר ברוחו איך לתקן את המעוות.


He then experiences a profound inner sorrow, and he probes into his spirit in order to discover how to rectify that which has been distorted.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:256:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:256:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:256:3)


כשהצער הפנימי מתגלה בכל תוקף שלו, כשהמצב החיצוני, נעשה רעוע, כמו בעת קלקלה וצרה, אז ההרגשה הפנימית איננה כ"כ איתנה, ומ"מ גם אז יכולה היא לבא למרום קצה, כי גם תשובה שע"י יסורין היא תשובה.


When that inner sorrow is revealed in all of its might, when a person’s external situation grows uncertain, as at a time of damage and trouble, then his inner feeling is not so firm. Yet nevertheless even then it can reach its peak, because repentance that arrives via sufferings is also repentance.



### Paragraph 257

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:257:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:257:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:257:1)


הצדיקים קשורים הם תמיד בדבקות בד' ית"ש, ואינם יכולים כלל לצייר להם חיים בלא נועם הדבקות האלהית.


**Overcoming Delusory Imagination**
Righteous people are ceaselessly connected to union with God. They cannot at all imagine for themselves a life absent of the pleasure of clinging to the Divine.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:257:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:257:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:257:2)


אמנם מפני שבכל רעיון אנושי מתערב הרבה מהדמיון הכוזב, ועמו יחד מתערבים המון מדות רעות, שהן מסתעפות כמו ענפים, היוצאים משורש קטן, וכגידולי זרעים רבים מגרעין,


But a great deal of delusory imagination is mixed into every human thought, and this imagination is accompanied by a multitude of evil traits, spreading like branches that emerge from a small root or like a profusion of plant life from a single seed.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:257:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:257:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:257:3)


על כן הם צריכים לברר ע"י תורה ומצות את הדבקות האלהית, שתהיה כולה ברה וקדושה.


Therefore, these people must clarify their clinging to the Divine by learning Torah and performing God’s commandments, so that this clinging will be entirely clear and holy.



### Paragraph 258

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:258:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:1)


הצחצוחים של המדות הרעות, המעורבים בתוך הכשרון של הדבקות האלהית שבנפש, הם פועלים את פעולתם לרעה יותר מהמדות הרעות שאצל רוב בנ"א, מפני שאין בעולם פעולה כ"כ אמיצה במעמקי הנפש כמו הדבקות האלהית, אשר על כן אין לשער את עומק וגודל החיים של הצדיקים, העומדים לפני ד', ומתענגים בנועם הדבקות והחשק האלהי, וכשהכח הכללי של החיים הוא גדול ואמיץ, גם החלק הרע שבהם הוא ג"כ אמיץ, כתוכן הפנימי של כל הגדול מחבירו יצרו גדול ממנו.


**The Entire Multitude of Details**
The abrasive effects of evil traits mixed into a righteous person’s ability to cling to the Divine have an effect more evil than the evil traits of most people. That is because there is no activity as powerful in the depth of a person’s being as clinging to the Divine. That is why one cannot imagine the depth and greatness of the life of the righteous, who stand before Hashem and delight in the pleasantness of clinging to and desiring the Divine. But when the overall power of life is great and powerful, the evil portion in that life is also powerful. That is in keeping with the inner content of our Sages’ statement, “Whoever is greater than another has a greater evil inclination” (*Succah* 52a).


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:258:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:2)


ומפני כך עומדים עומדים הצדיקים תמיד במצב של מלחמה נגד צחצוחי הרע שבהם, המעורב עם הטוב, כל זמן שהעולם לא נתבסם כולו.


Therefore, righteous people are in a constant state of war against the abrasive effects of the evil within themselves, which is mixed together with the good, as long as the world is not yet entirely refined.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:258:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:3)


אבל ד' לא יעזבם, והם תמיד הולכים מחיל אל חיל, כובשים ומנצחים.


But Hashem will not abandon them. And they constantly proceed from strength to strength, conquering and vanquishing.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:258:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:4)


ולעד לא יעזבו את תוכן החיים העקרי, שהוא הדבקות האלהית, כ"א תמיד יעלו אותו, יאמצוהו ויבררוהו, ובעלייתו ועלייתם עמו הכל מתעלה, כל העולם, כל החיים, כל ההויה.


They will never abandon the essential content of life, which is to cling to the Divine. But they will constantly raise it, empower it, and clarify it. And with its ascent and their ascent with it, everything ascends: the entire world, all life, all existence.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:258:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:258:5)


בהתרוממות היסוד יתרומם הבנין, ובאימוץ השורש יתאמצו השריגים והעלים כולם, יחד עם כל המוני פרטיותיהם.


With the elevation of the foundation, the building is elevated. And with the strengthening of the root, all of the branches and leaves grow strong, together with the entire multitude of their details.



### Paragraph 259

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:259:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:1)


הקריאה בשם ד' אחד, שואפת לגלות את האחדות בעולם, באדם, בעמים, ובכל התוכן של ההויה, באין פרץ בין המעשים והדיעות. בין השכל והדמיון.


**In a Single Bond**
A person who calls out in the name of Hashem, Who is one, aspires to reveal that oneness in the world: in man, in the nations, and in the entire content of existence, without any schism between deeds and perspectives, between intellect and imagination.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:259:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:2)


וגם הפרצים המורגשים יתאחדו ע"י ההארה העליונה, המכרת את צד אחדותם והתאמתם.


Even the apprehensible schisms will be united by the supernal illumination, which recognizes the aspect of the oneness of those elements that have been severed and of how they may come into alignment.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:259:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:3)


בתוכן החיים של האדם הוא יסוד הקדושה כולה בחיי הרוח הוא אור הנצח, חיי שעה וחיי עולם באגודה אחת.


In the content of a human being’s life, that unification is the foundation of all holiness. In the life of the spirit, it is the light of eternity, which brings together temporal life and eternal life in a single bond.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:259:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:259:4)


זאת היא המחשבה היותר גדולה שבמחשבות הענקיות של כח החושב אשר להאדם, המתגלה בקרבו ע"י כל כשרון הגילוי הרוחני שלו, עד מרום התגלות אלהות, באורח שכל, וידיעה של פנים אל פנים.


That thought of unification is the greatest thought among the giant thoughts in a human being’s power of thought. It is revealed in him as a result of his entire spiritual ability to reveal matters, reaching up to the height of the revelation of the Divine, along the path of the intellect and with knowledge that is direct and “face to face.”



### Paragraph 260

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:260:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:1)


התכונה של יראת שמים, מצד עצמה, לית לה מגרמה כלום, ואי אפשר לה להיות מתחשב בין הכשרונות ומעלות הנפש של האדם.


**The Fear of Heaven**
In itself, the trait of the fear of heaven “has nothing of its own at all” (*Zohar* 1:181a), and it cannot be considered among a person’s capacities and personal qualities.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:260:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:2)


היא כשהיא לעצמה, היא עלולה להוריד את האדם ואת האנושיות כולה לעמקי תהומות, כשם שהיא עלולה להעלותם למרומי שחקים.


In itself, it is as likely to lower a person and all mankind to the very lowest depths as to raise them to the heavenly heights.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:260:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:3)


אבל דוקא משום דלית לה מגרמה כלום היא מקבלת את כל האורות, היא אוצרת בקרבה את כל הכשרונות כולם, וכל כשרון מתברך ומובטח להיות נצור רק ע"פ ההערכה הנכבדה של יחושו להאוצר הגדול, אוצר של יראת שמים, שבו הכל גנוז.


But precisely because “it has nothing of its own,” it receives all of the spiritual lights and it stores within itself all abilities. And each ability is blessed and assured that it will be guarded only in accordance with the substantial value of its relationship with the great storehouse: the storehouse of the fear of heaven, in which everything is contained.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:260:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:4)


על כן יראת שמים מתרוממת לא כ"כ ע"פ העסק במעמקי עצמה, כמו שהיא מתעלה ע"י מה שממלאים אוצרה בכל דעת וכשרון, בתורה ובמצות, בכל מדה נכונה, בכל עז וגבורה, בכל תהילה ותפארת.


Therefore, the fear of heaven rises not so much as a result of people’s dealing with its depths as it rises as a result of people filling its storehouse with all knowledge and ability, with Torah and with mitzvot, with every proper trait, with all might and strength, with all praise and beauty.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:260:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:5)


נמצא שיראת שמים ויסוד הוייתה העולמית היא אספקלריא דלא נהרא, מצד עצמה, וכל עילויה הוא בהארת אור שמש העליון עליה, עד אשר תתאחד יפה ביסוד מקוריותה.


Thus, taking all this into account, the fear of heaven and the foundation of its universal existence is in itself a “non-shining lens.” Its entire elevation comes when the light of the supernal sun shines upon it, and ultimately it will unite well with its foundational source.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:260:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:260:6)


אז תעלה מעלה מעלה, ותהיה באמת עטרת תפארת לעמוסי בטן, כשתשוב מלאה טוב אל שורש מחצבה העליון, העשיר מכל השפעה נאצלת, המתפלגת לפלגות מיוחדות. כי היא בת נדיב, בתו של אברהם אבינו שנקרא נדיב, שבכל שמה, מקור הברכה כולה.


Then it will rise ever upwards, and it will truly be “a crown of beauty for those carried in the womb” (Blessing on the New Moon), when it returns filled with good to the supernal root of its supernal place from which it is hewed, richer than all emanated abundance divided into individual streams, because it is “the daughter of nobles” (*Song of Songs* 7:2), the daughter of our patriarch Abraham, who is called “a noble,” the daughter whose name is “in all” (*Bava Batra* 16b), the source of all blessing.



### Paragraph 261

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:261:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:261:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:261:1)


לא תמיד אפשר לדבר בעצם הענינים המהותיים, ע"כ ממלאים את הריקניות של המחשבה, במה שמדברים ע"ד המקרים החיצוניים של הענינים.


**Spiritual Geometry**
It is not always possible to speak about essential matters themselves. Therefore, we fill the emptiness of thought by speaking about these matters’ outer circumstances.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:261:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:261:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:261:2)


ומ"מ גם שיחות כאלה הן מביאות תועלת, וסוף כל סוף מביאים הם את האדם לידי כניסה בעצמיותם של הענינים.


Nevertheless, such conversations too bring benefit, and in the end they lead a person to enter into the essence of these matters.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:261:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:261:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:261:3)


ביחוד ראוי לדבר תמיד ע"ד הערכים של הענינים הנעלמים, כדמות חכמת המספר, ובשכל משוטט על ידי זה למעלה.


In particular, it is fitting to always speak about the external parameters of these concealed matters—like geometry, which describes an object’s physical dimension but not its intrinsic nature. And in this way, one soars upward with the intellect.



### Paragraph 262

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:262:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:262:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:262:1)


צריך להסביר עילוי הלימוד של רזי תורה, עם הדרישה לכבד את ההכרות הפנימיות של האדם, שהוא יסודו של עולם.


**The Inner Secrets of the Torah**
One must explain the elevated value of learning the secrets of the Torah by seeing it in the light of the quest to appreciate the inner states of awareness of the human being, who is the foundation of the world.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:262:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:262:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:262:2)


וכל הנפילה, שהעולם המתעלה בתרבותו החיצונה נופל הוא בערכו הפנימי, באה היא ממדה זו, שכל מה שהערך החיצון של התרבות הוא מתקדם, העין תופסת יותר את ההכרה החיצונה, ומוסיפה לזלזל את ההכרה הפנימית, ומתוך כך ערכו האמיתי של האדם פוחת ויורד.


As the world’s external culture rises, its internal value falls. Every such fall comes from the following phenomenon: the greater the progress of the external value of the culture, the more a person’s eye appreciates that which is seen externally and disparages that which is appreciated internally. As a result, appreciation of the human being’s true value diminishes and descends.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:262:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:262:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:262:3)


וגאולת העולם תלויה היא ברוממותם של ההכרות הפנימיות, שהן באות ומאירות ע"י העסק הכביר במעמקיהן, שהוא עצמו העסק הנלבב ברזי תורה, בקדושה ובטהרה, בענוה ואומץ רוח.


The redemption of the world depends on the elevation of these inner appreciations, which come and shine when a person engages in a mighty endeavor to engage with their depths. That endeavor is itself heartfelt engagement with the secrets of the Torah in holiness and purity, with humility and a firm spirit.



### Paragraph 263

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:263:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:263:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:263:1)


הטהרה הגופנית בכל פרטיה המעשיים וכל דקדודיה עד טבילת הגוף, היא דרושה מאד לתמם את כח המדמה על מכונו, ולהתאימו עם ההרגשים והדיעות המוסריות והשכליות, המוטבעות בעצמיות התכונה הפנימית של כנסת ישראל בערכה הרוחני העליון.


**Purity of the Body**
Purity of the body in all of its practical details and all of its specifics, including immersion of the body in a mikveh, is very much required to perfect the faculty of the imagination in its proper place and to align it with the ethical and intellectual feelings and perspectives that are impressed in the essence of the inner content of the Congregation of Israel on its supernal spiritual level.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:263:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:263:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:263:2)


והמעולים שבמכירים הפנימיים, הטביעה הזאת הולכת ומתפתחת בהם, עד שלא ימצאו מרגע לרוחם, כי אם כשימלאוה בכל הצדדים היותר מרוחבים.


The demand for that bodily purity constantly develops in the most elevated of those people who experience inner states of awareness until they can only find rest for their spirit when they fulfill this demand in all of its broadest aspects.



### Paragraph 264

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:264:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:1)


המעשים מתהפכים לדמיונות. בכח עיקול רוחני, והדמיונות להרגשות, וההרגשות למושכלות, והמושכלות לאופי רוחני קבוע, הפועל על כל התוכן המהותי.


**Proper Actions**
A person’s deeds are transformed into images in his mind via the power of spiritual assimilation, and those images are transformed into feelings, and those feelings are transformed into concepts, and those concepts are transformed into a fixed spiritual character, which affects a person’s entire essential character.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:264:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:2)


ומזה יש להבין, כמה גדולה היא האחריות של המעשים.


From this, one may understand how great is a person’s responsibility to engage in proper actions.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:264:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:3)


אמנם לא אצל הכל הקשר עומד בחזקה, וכח העיקול הרוחני איננו שוה אצל כל איש ואצל כל עם. בטפוסה המיוחד של היהדות, מונח ג"כ זה האופי, שהקשר בין החוליות הללו של המעשים, הדמיונות, הרגשות, המושכלות, והאופי הכללי, הוא חזק מאד, וכח העיקול הרוחני נשגב הוא.


However, this connection is not strong in all people. The power of spiritual assimilation is not the same in every person and in every nation. This characteristic lies in the unique mold of Judaism, in which the connection among these links of deeds, imagination, feelings, concepts, and overall character is very strong, and the power of spiritual assimilation is elevated.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:264:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:264:4)

Any breaking away from that—whether it comes from the aspect of flippancy and anarchy or whether from the aspect of elevation of the mind and arousal of the supernal spirit—is something of the “world of chaos.”

**The Imagination**
Most people live their spiritual life, and thus also a large portion of their practical life, in accordance with the influence of the imagination.

Only those people who are elevated and mighty in spirit rise to live an intellectual life, although they too are connected in their nature by many shackles to the imprisonment of the imagination, and they must contend extensively with the imagination.

**The Fear of Thinking**
The greatest failing in the character of the fear of heaven that is not bound well with the light of Torah is that the fear of sin exchanges places with the fear of thought. And when a person begins to fear thinking, he sinks into a swamp of ignorance, which removes the light of his soul, causes his power to stumble, and coarsens his spirit.

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:268:1

**Guarding the Character of the Soul**
Not by thought alone does a person live, but by the character of his soul, which he must guard more than anything else. It is a gift from God, and a person guards it specifically in the manner given by God: “Guard My commandments and live” (*Proverbs* 4:4).

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:269:1

**The Fear of Heaven**
A person must always engage in the general issue of the fear of heaven: to understand its character and to acquire it in its purity as the most precious quality of life. **Universal and Parochial Morality**
Regarding morality, a person must clarify the nature of abstract, absolute, universal morality, and he must clarify as well the morality connected to the fear of heaven. And he must contemplate the relationship between these separate parameters: how they differ from each other, and how they are united.

A person cannot live with intellect alone or with emotion alone. He must always blend intellect with emotion in an amalgam.

Only the trait of equilibrium that balances intellect with emotion will rescue him completely.

“Those who are wise of heart see the matter at the moment that it is revealed, before it has been clothed. They see it with a discerning eye. And although it is immediately sealed, it is not hidden from their eye” (*Zohar* 2:98b). **In Its Soul, Judaism Includes Everything**
They err, those who seek to define Judaism in regard to its soul and its spiritual character, although one may define it in regard to its revealed and perceivable content.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:273:2

That is because in its soul Judaism includes everything. All spiritual inclinations, revealed and hidden, are concealed in it in a supernal totality, just as everything is included in absolute Divinity, and every definition in relation to Divinity is a “cutting off of the shoots” and the erection of a statue and a molten form in order to present the Divine character.

**Trembling and Fear**
Trembling and fear are characteristics of a person’s psyche when it encounters an elevated vision, in whatever way that may occur. And there is no benefit in warring against these feelings.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:274:2

But if, as a result of a person’s weakness of thought and the destruction of his bodily and psychological powers, they grow too strong, then opposing powers justifiably appear to constrict them, so that they will not be able to damage the soul’s governance and the person’s dominion over himself and his social circle, with the force that his rule has attained justifiably.

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:275:1

**The Power of the Imagination**
Regarding all arguments based on philosophical proof related to the ways of faith that are in keeping with logical intellect, even when the forcefulness of such an argument has been annulled, such proofs at any rate retain their value in terms of their effect on a person’s power of imagination, which must be proper and whole. And the paths of a person’s life must align with his imagination in its state of wholeness.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:275:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:275:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:275:2)

In particular, we must take into account this power of the imagination in connection with Divine matters, because with all sorts of ways of clinging to the Divine, faith gives happiness—an absolute and eternal happiness—to the individual and to the people. And just as the intellect must be illuminated with Divine illumination, so too the power of the imagination must be illuminated with this illumination on its own level.

In order for us to attain the blossoming of thought and the fruitfulness of literature, it must be agreed that every imaginal and intellectual flower is a fruit of the soul, and that when we reveal it the world grows more refined, as the soulful aspiration as a whole tends to goodness.

The moon’s complaint (*Chullin* 60b) may be interpreted well in terms of the secrets of the psyche.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:2

If their value were equal from every aspect, the contradiction between them in spiritual life and so also in physical life would be great.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:4)


א"א לשני מלכים שישתמשו בכתר אחד. הרגש הקובל, אפשר לשכל להרחיב את עצמו עד כדי קבלת כל ההפכים. מה שא"כ ברגש.


The moon complained to the Holy One, blessed be He, “It is impossible for two kings—I and the sun—to make use of one crown.” That is to say, feeling complains that intellect can broaden itself to the extent of accepting all opposites, which is not the case with feeling.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:5)


עצה אחת יש ע"ז. לכי ומעטי את עצמך. הוי ראש לשועלים. בחיי המעשה, החברה, והנימוס, מלכי בכיפה,


There is one counsel for this: God told the moon, “Go, diminish yourself.” “Be the head of the foxes.” In the life of action, community, and politesse, feeling must “rule with authority.”


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:6)


אבל למעלה במקום העיונים העליונים, שם המאור הגדול מושל.


But above, in the place of supernal contemplations, the great light of intellect must rule.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:7)


אבל הקובלנא גדולה היא מאד,יש באמת מהלכים לרגש בעליונים ועליוני עליונים, גם בעמקי השכל עצמו וטוהר משפטיו.


However, the moon’s complaint is very great. There are in truth ways in which feeling proceeds in the higher realms and indeed in the very highest realms: even in the depths of the intellect and in the purity of its judgments.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:8)


הכח השכלי שברגש מוצא הוא בעושר ההתפרטות, מיעט את הלבנה לפיכך הרבה את צבאותיה. אבל בכ"ז לקוי הוא העולם מפני ירידתו של הרגש ממרומי שמיו.


This intellectual power that exists in feeling is found in the wealth of details associated with feeling: “God diminished the moon. Therefore, He gave it hosts of many stars.” Despite that, however, the world is defective because of the descent of feeling from its heavenly heights.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:9)


השכל ושורש עליוניותו מתעכב ג"כ ממהלכו, ונעכר מזכותו, ע"י הנמכתו של הרגש והגבלתו, ואי התחברותו התדירית באור השכל.


As a result, the intellect too, with the root of its supernal being, is prevented from proceeding on its way, and its clarity grows opaque as a result of the diminishment and limitation of feeling and its lack of a constant bond to the light of the intellect.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:10)


מביאים כפרה על האור האלהי. המונמך ע"י מיעוט הירח. משתדלים לדרוש מילוי פגימתה של הלבנה, העמדתה במשקל המאור הגדול, החיים המורגשים והשכליים ממוזגים ומשוקלים עין בעין. מה טוב ומה נעים יהיה אז העולם, מה נחמדים, כבירים, עליזים וקדושים החיים.


We must bring an atonement for the Divine light having been diminished as a result of the diminishment of the moon. We strive to seek the fulfillment of the flaw of the moon, to place it in balance with the great light, so that the felt life and intellectual life will be equally blended and balanced. How good and how pleasant will the world then be, how pleasing, mighty, exuberant, and holy will life then be!


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:11)


יהר מלפניך, ד' או"א, שתמלא פגימת הלבנה, ולא יהיו בה שום מיעוט, ויהיה אור הלבנה כאור החמה: כאור שבעת ימי בראשית, כמו שהיתה קודם מיעוטה, כמו שנאמר ויעש אלהים את שני המאורת הגדולים.


“May it be Your will, Hashem our God and the God of our fathers, that the flaw of the moon will be made whole, and it will not suffer any diminishment. And may the light of the moon be like the light of the sun, like the light of the seven days of Creation as it was before its diminishment. As the verse states, ‘God made the two great lights’ (*Genesis* 1:16)” (Blessing on the New Moon).


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:12)


וכמו החיים הפרטיים, כמו כן החברותיים יקבלו את צורתם החדשה, השלמה והבהירה.


And just like individual life, so too will communal life receive its new, whole, and bright shape.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:279:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:279:13)


החפץ היותר כמוס במרומי הסתר השכלי, והגלוי במעמקי לבב, בסידור האומה וחסנה, יחדיו יעמדו שלובים זה בזה. ויתקיים בנו מקרא שכתוב, ובקשו את ד' אלהיהם ואת דוד מלכם אמן סלה.


The most hidden desire in the heights of the intellectual concealment, and that which is revealed in the depths of the heart, in the arrangement of the nation and its might, will stand together, intertwined. And the verse will be realized in us, “Seek Hashem your God and David your king” (*Hosea* 3:5). Amen selah.



### Paragraph 280

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:280:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:280:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:280:1)


כנסת ישראל נקראת קיר בדרך רז. כלומר, המעמד המוחש, שהרעיונות פונים אליו בשביל כל הענינים של היהדות והאמונה.


**Our Recognition of the Divine**
The Congregation of Israel is called “a wall” in an esoteric sense. That is to say, it is a discernible position to which our thoughts turn in order to attain all of the matters of Judaism and faith.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:280:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:280:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:280:2)


ובהיקף הכללי של העולם היא ההכרה האלהית, הבאה מתוך ההסתכלות של העולם והמציאות המוחשית, והגילוי הרוחני הקרוב, הפועל על החיים והמוסר.


And more broadly, in the general scope of the world, it is our recognition of the Divine, which comes from our looking at the world and discernible reality, and the revelation of the spirituality that is near this world, which has an effect on life and ethics.



### Paragraph 281

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:281:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:1)


האישיות, בכל התפשטות הכח שלה, היא תובעת את דקיונה מהמוסר, ומהדת, בזמן שהם באים לעצור את הטוב והצדק שיש בה.


**The Wildness Within Ourselves**
Mankind, in all of the expansion of its might, demands to retrieve its human image from inadequate ethics and religion when these come to block the good and the just within mankind.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:281:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:2)


אבל לעולם אין המוסר ולא הדת מכוונים כ"א לעצר את הרע והפראות שבאישיות, ומאד צריך האדם לזיכוך מדותיו, והארת דעותיו, עד כדי להבין ולחוש את אותו הצד הפראי והרשעי שבו, שהוא צריך להיות נעצר ע"י הדת והמוסר, ולדעת ג"כ את הצד של האור והטוב שבו, שהוא עומד למעלה מהתפקיד של הדת והמוסר, במובנם המצוי.


But in truth ethics and religion are directed only to block evil and wildness within humanity. And a person profoundly requires the purification of his traits and the illumination of his perspectives so that he may understand and apprehend this wild and evil aspect within himself, which religion and ethics must block. And he must also know the aspect of light and goodness within himself, which stand above the function of religion and ethics as they are commonly understood.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:281:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:3)


התרבות מגלה היא צדדים רבים של טוב ושל אור בנפש האדם, במקום שהיה נחשב לרשע ופראות, וכשהיא מוצאה בנקודות הללו מעצורים מצד הדת והמוסר, היא נלחמת בהם ומנצחתם.


Modern culture reveals many aspects of goodness and light in a person’s psychology, in an area that had previously been thought to be wickedness and wildness. And when, in those points, it finds blockages created by religion and ethics, it wars against them and conquers them.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:281:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:4)


אבל אחרית המלחמה היא הגילוי, שמגלים הדת והמוסר בעצמם את אורם, עד שנמצא החופש האישי הזה, ותביעותיו הטבעיות הטובות, הוא מוכר לאחד מככרי הדת והמוסר עצמם,


But the end of the war will be our revelation that religion and ethics themselves reveal their light until this human freedom, with its natural, good demands, will be recognized as being one of the pavilions of religion and ethics.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:281:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:281:5)


וממילא מתאשר עוד ביותר הכח של הדת והמוסר לשלוט על הצד הפראי שבאדם, ולהיות מכובד ואהוב מצד העליון והטוב שבו.


And the power of religion and ethics will gain greater authority to rule over the wild aspect within man, and man will be honored and beloved due to the aspect of the supernal and the good within him.



### Paragraph 282

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:1)


שתי שיטות הן לערכה של התפילה: השיטה המיסטית והשיטה הרציונלית.


**Mystical and Rationalist Prayer**
There are two approaches to the value of prayer: the mystical approach and the rationalist approach.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:2)


הראשונה מבארת את קשר העולם עם האדם ועם תנועותיו כולן, ומראה בעליל, שהבעת הרצון הנפשי של האדם בהתדבקו באלהים, הרי היא פועלת ויוצרת מתוך המעמד הרוחני עלילות רבות-ערך בההויה בכללה, וממילא באה הפעולה לטובה בהנוגע לחלקו של האדם ומבוקשיו.


The first—the mystical approach—explains that there is a connection between the universe and man with all of his movements. It shows patently that the expression of the will of a person’s psyche as he clings to God brings about and creates out of his spiritual stance multileveled effects on all existence, and automatically that effect acts for the good in regard to that person’s individual portion and his request.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:3)


השיטה הרציונלית אינה מכרת את הסתרים הנפלאים הללו, והיא מכנסת את התפילה כולה לתוך המערכה המוסרית, הפסיכית, הפיוטית. האדם יתרומם ע"י ציורי תפילתו, נפשו תזדכך, מדותיו יתעלו.


The rationalist approach, on the other hand, does not recognize these hidden wonders. Rather, it inserts the entirety of prayer into an ethical, psychological, poetic framework. According to that, a person is elevated by means of the images of his prayer. His psyche is purified and his traits rise.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:4)


התוכן המוסרי הוא בודאי אחוז עם הגורל של האדם, בההטבה המוסרית יוטב הגורל, ההויה כולה שואפת לקדמה לטוב, הרשעה היא נפלטת מהמציאות, ובזה הננו מכירים את סיבת הפגעים כולם מהרשעה.


Certainly, a person’s ethical content is intertwined with his destiny. With his ethical improvement, his destiny will improve. Then all reality aspires to advance to goodness, and wickedness flees from existence. And as that occurs, we recognize the cause of all of the injuries caused by wickedness.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:5)


ההטבה הנפשית שע"י חיקוי השירי של התפילה, היא התכלית.


The psychological improvement in a person that comes about by means of the emulation in prayer of the poetic: that is the goal.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:6)


אין לקשר את התפילה בפרטיות של הפעולה המבוקשת, ע"פ השיטה המדוברת, אלא מצטרפת היא מתוך הכלל.


According to the rationalist approach under discussion, a person should not connect prayer with the detail of his desired outcome. Rather, that outcome joins his prayer out of the totality of his prayer.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:7)


היא מכרת שהאדם שלא יתפלל, יצטברו בתוכו הרבה תכונות קשות מחוסרות תיקון ועידון, ומצבו המוסרי יסבול מזה הרבה. ולהיפוך, ע"י התפילה יתעלה האדם, ויהיה יותר מואר ברוחניותו, וממילא יהיו חפציו יותר ממולאים. בכלל יקרה היא האידיאליות של התפילה, הבעת הנשמה, יותר מעצם התכלית הפרטי של המבוקש שבתפילה.


Rationalist prayer recognizes that if a person does not pray, many adverse traits that lack repair and refinement will accumulate within him, and his ethical situation will consequently suffer greatly. Conversely, by means of prayer a person will rise and his spirituality will be more illuminated, and so his desires will be more fulfilled. In general, the idealism of prayer, the expression of the soul, is more precious than the gist of the particular goal that a person seeks in his prayer.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:8)


מובן שלשיטה זו, צריך המצב האידיאלי להיות יותר מזוכך, כדי שתהיה התפילה מוכרת לדבר של חובה גדולת ערך.


It may be understood that according to this rationalist approach, the ideal situation in itself must be more purified in order for prayer to be recognized as something obligatory that is of great worth.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:282:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:282:9)


אמנם השיטה השניה, היא ממולאה מאידיאליות פנימית המוזרת מההויה כולה בתוכה, אבל היא מספקת להמשיך לבבות אל קביעותה.


However, the mystical approach is filled with an inner idealism woven together with all of existence within itself. But although it is so exalted, it suffices to draw people’s hearts to establish its permanence in their lives.



### Paragraph 283

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:283:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:283:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:283:1)


מה אני מרגיש כשאני נתבע לעיין ברוחניות - מחלת לב ומועקה. למה הוא הדבר הזה? מפני שהתביעה הרוחנית מתגברת בקרבי, ונפשי מרגשת אז ביותר את עניותה המוסרית והרוחנית בכלל.


**Overcoming Sickness in the Soul**
What do I feel when I am summoned to study matters of the spirit? A sickness of the heart and discomfort. Why is this so? Because as that spiritual demand grows stronger within me, my spirit grows especially aware of its moral poverty, and of its spiritual poverty in general.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:283:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:283:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:283:2)


אמנם הרפיון הנפשי הנולד מהופעה זו, הוא חסרון מוחלט. זוהי חלודה נשמתית. נגד זה צריך להלחם באמץ לב. ההסתכלות הרוחנית צריכה להיות עשירה, תדירה ורחבה, תקיפה והולכת ביושר.


The spiritual weakness born of this phenomenon is an absolute imperfection; it is a stain upon the soul. One must battle against it with a stalwart heart. The spiritual gaze must be rich, constant and broad, powerful and straightforward.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:283:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:283:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:283:3)


החולשה והכאב הפנימי, שהתבערה של יראת שמים מחוללת בקרב הנפש, היא מצד עצמה חסרון ומחלה, וצריכים לקנות מושגים ברורים במקצע של קודש זה, עד שהסילוד הבלתי תרבותי יהיה הולך ופוחת, ובמקומה תבא עצמה והרחבת הדעת.


The weakness and inner pain caused within the spirit by the conflagration of the fear of heaven is in itself an imperfection and sickness. One must acquire clear concepts in this area of holiness until this uncultured aversion will decrease and be replaced with strength and a broad consciousness.



### Paragraph 284

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:284:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:284:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:284:1)


הרגש כלול הוא בשכל. והוא המדרגה התחתונה שבו. כשהוא יוצא לפעול פעולות מעשיות, אז קובע לו את תחומו הרגשי בפני עצמו.


**Emotion Is the Lowest Level of the Intellect**
Emotion is incorporated within the intellect. It is the lowest level of the intellect. When it emerges to execute practical actions, it establishes its own emotional realm in and of itself, independent of the intellect.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:284:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:284:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:284:2)


בחיים העולמיים כולם הוא התוכן הסודי של אות ה"א האחרונה של שם, שהיא נעשית שם אדני בפ"ע.


In all life within worlds, emotion is the mystical character of the second letter hey of the Divine Name, which in itself becomes the name, “Master.”



### Paragraph 285

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:285:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:285:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:285:1)


התפילה, וחלק גדול ממעשה המוסר והתורה. בנויים הם על יסוד תקנת הרגש של האדם. והם צריכים לשמור גבולם.


**Balancing Emotion and Intellect**
A person’s prayer and a large portion of his activity related to ethics and Torah are built upon the foundation of his repairing his emotional aspect. These must guard their realm and remain within the purview of emotion.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:285:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:285:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:285:2)


כשבאים אל הרגש בענינים ותוכנים שכליים אין מצליחים.


If, instead, we bring to our emotion matters and subjects that are of an intellectual nature, we will not succeed.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:285:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:285:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:285:3)


אמנם עצמותה של התביעה, שיהיה הרגש ג"כ מושכל, יש לה מקום, מפני שבאמת אינינו גם חטיבה בפ"ע, אלא אחד מצדדי השכל, שהוא מתגלה במדרגתו התחתונה.


However, the essence of the demand that emotion be included within the realm of the intellect has its place. That is because in truth emotion is not a unit in and of itself, but one of the aspects of the intellect, one that is revealed on the intellect’s lowest plane.



### Paragraph 286

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:286:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:286:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:286:1)

**Everything Will Be Recognized as Good**
Everything that is called into being in the world, from the earliest generations until the last, consists partially of aspirations and partially of recognitions. And these two continuously combine into a complete creation.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:286:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:286:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:286:2)


עד שלא באה הצורה המשלימה, המכנסת את הכל אל שלמותה, יש בהם טוב ורע, אמת ושקר, טומאה וטהרה, קודש וחול.


Until the coming of the form that completes everything, that implants everything in its state of wholeness, these phenomena possess both good and evil, truth and falsehood, impurity and purity, the holy and the mundane.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:286:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:286:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:286:3)


אבל כשיופיע האור של ההתאחדות הכוללת, שיהיה מבורר כל אלה השאיפות וחלקי ההכרות למה הן באות, אז הכל יוכר לטוב, לאמת, לטהרה, ולקודש, עולם שכולו שבת, שכולו טוב.


But when the light of the inclusive unification will appear so that the goal to which all of these aspirations and partial recognitions are coming will be clear, then everything will be recognized as good, as truth, as purity and as holiness: a world that is entirely Sabbath, that is entirely good.



### Paragraph 287

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:287:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:287:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:287:1)


שינוי האויר מקור לחום ומחום לקור ברוחניות, מזיק הוא לבריאות הנשמה, כמו שצינים פחים מזיקים לגוף, ושומר נפשו ירחק מדרך עקש זה.


**Spiritual Climates**
A change of atmosphere from cold to hot or from hot to cold in spirituality damages the health of the soul, just as physical heat and cold damage the body. And “a person who guards himself will distance himself from this way of the corrupt” (*Proverbs* 22:5).


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:287:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:287:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:287:2)


הנשמה הישראלית צריכה לחיות באויר רוחני ישראלי. והכרח הוא להשביעה תמיד מהטוב הגנוז באוצר החיים של ישראל, ואם תרעה בשדה אחר תתחלש ותחלה, כי אם בהיות לה כל האמצעיים הדרושים לשמירה מכל מחלה, המתרגשת מהשינויים של האקלימים הרוחניים.


The soul of a person of Israel must live in an Israelite spiritual atmosphere. He must constantly satiate his soul with the goodness hidden in the treasury of life of Israel. If his soul will graze in another field, it will grow weak and ill, unless it has every means it needs to guard it from every illness. This is because it is sensitive to the changes of the spiritual climates.



### Paragraph 288

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:288:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:288:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:288:1)


התשובה קדמה לעולם,


**Returning to the Source**
Repentance preceded the world.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:288:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:288:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:288:2)


המוסר מקיף את הכל.


Ethics embraces everything.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:288:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:288:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:288:3)


הערך העליון המוחלט מתפלש הוא בכל ענפי ענפים. המעשה המסתעפת, שאינו מכוונת לשרשה, חוזרת למקורה בעלוי הרצון.


The absolutely supernal state of being penetrates all of the branches and sub-branches of existence. When a person’s will is elevated, any deed that had deviated so that it was not aligned with its root returns to its source.



### Paragraph 289

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:289:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:289:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:289:1)


הטבע אינה יודעת ממוסר וצדק, כי אם שואף לחפצו, לבנות ולהרוס, לנבל ולהצמיח. וכן הטבע הפרטי של האדם אינינו יודע כ"א את חפצו המיוחד,


**Illuminating Nature**
Nature does not know anything of ethics and justice. Rather, it aspires to attain its own desire: to build and to destroy, to decay and to flower. So too, the individual nature of a person only knows its own desire.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:289:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:289:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:289:2)


אבל הקדושה היא מתפשטת, מתגברת ע"י ההשפעות של המעשים הטובים והלימודים, התעוררות ההרגשות הקדושות, ע"י תפילה ועבודת קודש, עד שמאירה את מאור המוסר גם בטבע האדם.


But holiness spreads. It gains strength due to the influences of a person’s good deeds and learning, the arousal of his holy feelings, and due to his prayer and holy service, until it causes the light of ethics to shine even in his nature.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:289:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:289:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:289:3)


הארה זו נעשית היא ג"כ בדוגמתה בהויה כולה, והאור הנעים הטוב של הקודש, של המוסר העולמי, הולך וחודר בכל ההויה, עד שהיא מתאימה עם טבעה לתכונת המוסר, והצדק העליון, שבהופעת הקודש העליונה הכוללת.


Similarly, this illumination occurs in all existence. And the pleasant, good light of holiness, of universal ethics, continuously penetrates all existence, until existence with its nature is aligned with the character of ethics and supernal justice within the inclusive, supernal manifestation of the holy.



### Paragraph 290

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:290:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:1)


שפעת החיים היציריים. ממקור החיים, הולכת ושופעת היא ליצירה העליונה, יצירת השכל, הטוב, והשירה, משתפלת היא דרגה אחר דרגה, עד שיוצרת את החמריות, נעשית טבעית קשה, חשוכה, קשורה לחק עפר אבן וברזל.


**The Secret Flower of This World**
Creative life flows continuously from the Source of life to supernal creation, creating intellect, goodness, and song. It then descends level after level until it creates physicality, becoming something natural, hard, dark, connected to the law of dust, stone and bronze.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:290:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:2)


בדרגותיה אשר ירדה, זוכרת היא שפעה זו את אורה הראשון. משתוקקת היא לשוב לימי חסנה וזיוה, פונה היא מטביעתה הירידית, ומפסקת מצעוד עוד צעדים בשפל, פונה היא לעלות, להיותמוארת מאור של מעלה, מהאור של מקור הוייתה.


Then, on the levels to which it has descended, this flow remembers its original light. It yearns to return to the days of its might and radiance. It turns from its low, sunken state and ceases striding ever downward. It turns to rise, to be illuminated by the light from above, by the light of the source of its existence.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:290:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:3)


את השתלשלותה אבדה, כיון שפנתה למעלה, אין זה מהלך הזרם ההולך ויורד, אבל נתעשרה בעושר רוחני פנימי, מתחברת היא עם המאור העליון, השפעה של הויית הישות, הרוחני, האצילי, השכלי, והמוסרי, הקדוש והמצוחצח.


It loses its downward development. It turns upward, and so there is no longer a process of a continuously descending stream. Instead, it is enriched with an inner spiritual wealth. It bonds with the supernal light, with a flow that brings about a spiritual, noble, intellectual and ethical, holy and burnished existence.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:290:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:4)


מהחיבור הנעלה מתחדשים אורות ונגוהות רבות, יצירות נפלאות, שבהן מתגלה הכבדות הארצית, עם השאיפה השמימית המנצחתה.


From this exalted bond, many lights and luminosities, wondrous creations, are innovated, in which earthy heaviness together with triumphant heavenly aspiration is revealed.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:290:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:290:5)


נשמת האדם, בכל חגויה השונים, היא פרח רז עולם זה.


The soul of the human being with all of its various niches is the secret flower of this world.



### Paragraph 291

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:291:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:291:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:291:1)


עז החכמה העליונה במרום גבורתה, לא תצא לפעול חוץ מחוגה, די לה עצמיותה הנשגבה.


**Softening the Terrible Ice**
The might of supernal wisdom in the heights of its strength will not emerge to act outside its circle. Its exalted intensity suffices for itself.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:291:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:291:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:291:2)


אבל אור החסד זורם עליה לרכך את קרחה הנורא, שיעשה נהר פלגים מים קרים נוזלים, להופיע ממנו המון בריות לאין תכלית.


But the light of kindness streams upon it to soften its terrible ice, so that it will become a river of currents of cold, fluid waters, from which an abundance of creatures without end will appear.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:291:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:291:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:291:3)


והולכת הצטיירות החכמה ומתגלמת בכל יצור וכל מפעל.


And wisdom takes on form and is realized in every creature and in every activity.



### Paragraph 292

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:292:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:292:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:292:1)


כיצד הנשמה נבנית: למדים הרבה, מעיינים, חוזרים ומשננים את הידיעות, מתרגלים בההרגשות ע"י התורה והשינון, ואח"כ צומחות מזה הסתעפיות רוחניות, הקובעות אופי מיוחד.


**How Is Our Soul Built?**
How is our soul built? We learn much Torah, we study, and we return to review its ideas. As a result of our Torah learning and review, we grow accustomed to attaining sensitivity, and afterwards spiritual offshoots blossom from that, imparting a particular character to our soul.



### Paragraph 293

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:293:1

**Holy Emanation Will Vanquish Everything**
A plant rises with its vegetative power. The cedar and cypress grow with the currents of their powers.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:293:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:2)


חיים תקיפים חיה הטבעיות בקרבה, לא תדע מטרה מכוונת אצילית ברוחה, לא תכף עצמה מפני כל עילוי. זהו סוד חסנה ופראותה גם יחד.


Naturalness lives with a forceful life within itself. That naturalness does not know anything of a directed goal. It is noble in its spirit. It does not subjugate itself to any elevation. That is the secret of its power and of its wildness.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:293:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:3)

The soul of the human being lives in the heights of creation. That soul directs itself and it looks; it subjugates itself and its might to an elevation of holiness.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:293:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:4)


הוא ישגא בחילו - בכחו המופלא להיות גבור מעצמו, יותר מכחותיו החיים בקרבו, מהעולם שאין בו מחשבה ומטרה מוסרית - אצילות הקודש.


A person rises with his strength, with his wondrous power, to be mighty from within his intrinsic self more than from the powers of life within him that come from the world that has no ethical thought and goal.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:293:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:293:5)


את הכל ינצח. כל שתה תחת רגליו.


The holy emanation will vanquish everything. “God has placed everything under its feet” (*Psalms* 8:17).



### Paragraph 294

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:294:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:294:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:294:1)

**Timelessness and Domination**
When a person’s understanding rises, it activates his spiritual memory. Spiritual elevation conquers time, and so forgetfulness—all of whose power is the function of time—has no dominion.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:294:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:294:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:294:2)


ההנחה האפלטונית, שכל הלימודים הנם רק עניני הזכרה, היא באמת קרובה לאורחא דמהימנותא.


The Platonic conception that all learning is only a matter of remembering is in truth close to the path of faith.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:294:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:294:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:294:3)


וכל מי שיודע שם שלמ"ב ומשמרו בטהרה, תלמודו מתקיים בידו. וע"י עילוי רוחני זה, תכונת השליטה מתגלה בנפש, ואימתו מוטלת על הבריות.


When a person knows the 42-letter Divine name and guards it in purity, he retains his Torah learning. As a result of this spiritual elevation, the character of dominance is revealed in his psyche, and people are daunted before him.

נשמתי רחבה, גדולה ואדירה.

My soul is broad, great and mighty.

###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:295:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:295:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:295:3)


בלא מעצור אני צריך לחשוב, בלא מעצור - להציג על הגיליון את כל הגות לבבי.


I must think without constraint. Without no hindrance, I must inscribe on paper all the contemplation of my heart.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:295:4

איני מקפיד איך יעלו הדברים, בדרך נסתר או נגלה, הכל אחד. סוף כל סוף האור יתנוצץ.


I do not so much care how these matters will be expressed, whether in a hidden or a revealed manner. It is all one—in the end, the light will sparkle.

That which is in the character of Israel to generate and create: that is the oral Torah.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:296:2

**Slowly Rectifying Everything**
When a person wants all of his senses and inner characteristics to be immediately sanctified in accord with a spiritual ascent of awareness that he has experienced, and he also wants all of the blemishes in his everyday life to be straightened out immediately and perfected with an absolute rectification, he no longer finds a firm basis for his spirit, and he cannot strengthen his will so that it will stride upon the road of true perfection.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:299:2

But the all-inclusive crux of the matter is that a person must raise his awareness and intensify the light of the Torah in his life. And he proceeds in this way, rising upwards, until he succeeds in rectifying everything.

But despite the slowness of his progress he should not allow anything to disrupt him from his spiritual strides, which must be in accordance with the inner plane that his soul within him demands he reach.

Foreign thoughts in prayer come because of the general question regarding the topic of prayer that arises in a person’s mind: it is apparently inapposite, because we cannot attribute any change of will at all to the Holy One, blessed be He, and particularly as a result of placation and prayer.


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:304:2

And these foreign thoughts are removed only in keeping with those answers via which prayer makes sense. Overall, these consist of the following two concepts:


###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:304:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:304:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Shemonah%20Kevatzim/r/1:304:3)

One: prayer is built upon a person’s feelings and not upon his intellect. ###### Shemonah Kevatzim 1:304:4

This bringing-into-being decrees that man will be able to fulfill all of his functions in regard to the Divine guidance of the world. And one of the important functions is giving place to prayer. All of the divisions of the intentions of prayer branch out from these roots. In accordance with their broadening and deepening, they eliminate foreign thoughts, and they make prayer a pure prayer.
